name: agent-lab
description: Agent Lab — the hands-on training marketplace for the Enterprise AI Fluency course. Add this marketplace, then install `lab` (the 8-hour Agent Lab, /lab:start) or `support-lab` (the 90-minute Support Lab, say 'lab start').

plugins.name: lab
plugins.description: Tutor for the Agent Lab training: four 2-hour modules covering the Claude Code harness, RAG and retrieval, knowledge graphs and ontologies, and building a full AI system behind a human approval gate — by building one real plugin across all four. Run /lab:start to begin.

plugins.name: support-lab
plugins.description: Tutor for the Support Lab, Module 1 (about 90 minutes): investigate a real ticket with Claude Code the way a senior engineer would, one prompt at a time, then turn the method into an installable plugin and run it on a second ticket. No code — you ask, Claude Code investigates, you judge. Say 'lab start' to begin.
